text:
Shayne Gostisbehere won the Stanley Cup with Carolina last spring, and the Hurricanes are still using him the way that suits him: about 17 and a half minutes a night, a power-play role and the freedom to push. Twelve points in 18 games, ten of them assists, and The Hockey News called him a "Key Offensive Dynamo" this week.

The numbers back that up, with one caution. Carolina takes 64% of the shot attempts at five on five with him on, a dominant share, and is 4.5 points better in expected goals than without him. But the Hurricanes have also scored about five more goals than their chances deserved with him out there, so some of those assists are teammates finishing hot. Evolving-Hockey's note from last season fits: he drives play, and he plays with strong teammates, which flatters raw numbers. All seven of his points in the last ten games were assists. Expect the assist pace to cool a little, and the role to stay exactly where it is.
headline: The Cup champion's offensive engine
